meta.title: feat(backend): Integrate GCS file storage with automatic expiration for Agent File Input
meta.body_summary: Add complete GCS cloud storage infrastructure with automatic expiration for file uploads, replacing base64 data with file_uri references for improved performance and scalability.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code implemented a complete GCS storage layer with async operations, user-scoped authorization, and file expiration; merged after multiple merge conflict resolutions and AutoGPT-Agent bot feedback on checklist formatting.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At ~23k changed lines across 186 files, this is a large refactor by absolute volume, with significant churn from lock files and merge commits. Despite the size, the core performance-related change is the introduction of a cloud storage handler. The PR was merged after multiple rounds of conflict resolution and bot feedback, indicating maintainers found the change acceptable despite its scale.

review_details.concern_detail: No substantive human review comments; ntindle's formal review was DISMISSED then APPROVED without body text. A pr_comment from ntindle noted frontend scrollbar issues but approved backend changes. Multiple AutoGPT-Agent bot comments requested checklist formatting but did not block merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce memory usage and network overhead by using GCS file URIs instead of base64 data in agent inputs, with user-scoped storage and automatic expiration.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Complex cloud storage infrastructure with async GCS operations, authorization, and expiration; Agent delivered a comprehensive solution that required multiple fix commits and merge conflict resolutions. Maintainers accepted the backend design despite UI concerns.

detection_detail.code_reading: ntindle's pr_comment on frontend scrollbar issue shows manual UI testing; backend logic accepted without detailed review.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Deepsource analysis flagged code health issues; Netlify and Vercel deployment previews were generated.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes 27+ cloud storage tests and 7 upload endpoint tests, but no before/after benchmarks measuring performance improvement.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Multiple fix commits resolved test failures, merge conflicts, and parameter issues; no regressions were reported.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced CloudStorageHandler with async GCS operations, file upload endpoint returning file_uri (gcs://...), maintained base64 fallback for builder nodes, and added user-scoped authorization and automatic expiration.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many secondary changes are from merging dev branch (e.g., lock files, new blocks, migrations) and are not directly related to performance.
change_trajectory: Initial commit by Claude AI: comprehensive GCS storage with custom cleanup and monitoring (later simplified).
Refactor: removed custom cleanup, relied on bucket lifecycle policies.
Multiple fix commits by majdyz: resolved errors, test failures, and merge conflicts.
